svg.title: katana architecture, layer by layer
svg.desc: Layered diagram of katana. From the top: apps (console and desktop working, web and OpenAI server partial); UIOE, the layer before the model (interpret, classify, route, retrieve, orchestrate, context builder; partial); agent and tools (working, with LSP, sub-agents and the safety model partial); inference engine (GGUF, quantization, caches and MoE expert cache working; grammar and embeddings partial; speculation by copy disabled); hardware backends (CPU, Vulkan, OpenCL, CUDA for images). On the right: code intelligence, UCGE (spec to typed IR to AST to code; parser and Python backend working, other backends planned) and the image engine (Stable preview, then FLUX final).

g.title: katana console: working. CLI, -p headless
Desktop (Qt 6 / QML): working. Linux only
katana web: partial. browser tab, work in progress
serve: OpenAI API: partial. tiny models only so far
Interpret: partial
Classify: partial
Route: partial
Retrieve: partial
Orchestrate: partial
Context Builder: partial
Facades: Find, Symbols: partial. KATANA_UIOE=full, not default
memory.recall: partial. memory as dated evidence
Cache, web, MCP: planned. result cache, U9, external
Trust classes: planned. prompt-injection defence
Agent loop: working. sessions, compaction, teacher
12 declared tools: working. Bash Read Edit Write Find ...
25 on demand: working. ToolSearch loads the rest

No confirm default: partial. KATANA_CONFIRM=1 asks

svg.text: src/engine/ one C file, no external service

g.title: GGUF + tokenizers: working. Qwen3.6 and Gemma 4 main
Quantized formats: working. Q*_K, IQ, MXFP4; qtest
KV + prefix cache: working. fp16, saved to disk
MoE expert cache: working. VRAM slots by heat
Grammar calls: partial. no real-model measure
Speculation by copy: disabled. 0.7-0.8x: off by default
EmbeddingGemma: partial. reorders only; wired by hand
convert, quantize, train: partial. tiny models only
Index store + crawler N0-N3: partial. built, nothing timed on a real tree
g.text: built, nothing timed on a real tree
